title: Have you been to the arrival station in front of mall world?
content: Wondering if mall world is where I went. I started at this concrete arrival station with others and made my way down. Found my way into this clown shaped canoes which led me inside a building with very high ceilings. I thought it was a casino but could have been wrong. There was what appeared to be a theater entrance so I wonder if this area was near mall worlds theater.
